implementation.behavior: For complete DWG-to-DXF export, refuse only AC1012 sources whose NOD has a unique ACAD_MLINESTYLE root, the rooted child DICTIONARY is unique, and that dictionary contains a matching typed MLINESTYLE owned by it. The guard remains active if opaque callback output becomes qualified. Explicit AllowPartial does not trigger this guard.

limitations: The scratch DWGs are specification-directed LibreDWG outputs, not AutoCAD-authored producer evidence.
No AutoCAD normal-open or duplicate-key clone/merge operation was run; native merge semantics remain unqualified.

Generated DWG/DXF files remain outside the repository.
